  • accessories that stand out, offering a range of styles that suit many different tastes [2 marks for

  • crochet designs. Popular stitches include the chain stitch, single crochet, double crochet, and slip
  • stitch [2 marks for the tool and st itches]. Commonly used for making scarves, hats, bags,
